faq.q: What is territorial intelligence at Land Advisors?
faq.a: It is the integrated reading of land, regulation, connectivity, local market and property vocation — before recommending buy or pass on a piece of land. We do not show properties: we help you decide with criteria.

faq.q: Where do I start if I have never bought in the south?
faq.a: The guide to buying land in southern Chile orders the process in six steps (use, budget, sectors, enabling, infrastructure and asking for help). If you still do not have a zone defined, the strategic diagnostic (1 UF) is the usual first service.
No. Our content is educational and territorial consultancy. Before making an offer, check regulation and documents with a lawyer and competent professionals.
